#
# Generated by tools/public-surface.sh from the JVM build. Do not edit by
# hand; run 'tools/public-surface.sh --update'.
#
# Members are sorted rather than listed in declaration order, so the file is
# stable across compiler versions. Three groups of mechanically derived
# members are omitted so that a diff shows intent rather than noise:
#
#   * case-class and object boilerplate: productArity, productPrefix,
#     productElement, productElementName, productElementNames,
#     productIterator, canEqual, equals, hashCode, toString, fromProduct,
#     copy$default$N, MODULE$, and the static initializer;
#   * positional _N accessors, which restate the named field accessors while
#     the apply and copy signatures already record the full field list;
#   * a companion object whose members are all reachable as static
#     forwarders on the class of the same name;
#   * Scala synthetic accessors whose names contain $$;
#   * members that mention SpectralCore, which exists only as a Scaladoc
#     workaround for package-private constructor parameters and is not
#     part of the ordinary analyst surface.
#
# A synthesized apply, copy, or unapply IS listed. Those are what let a
# caller construct a fitted result that never came out of a fit, so they
# belong in any review of the surface.
